'''Shinqo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who served as [[Jet Nebula]]'s [[First Mate/Legends|First Mate]] aboard the ''[[Auriga Fire]]'' during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
Several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the signing of the [[Treaty of Coruscant]], Shinqo led a mutiny against Nebula when the ''Auriga Fire'' intercepted the ''[[Cinzia]]''. Holding Nebula at [[Blaster/Legends|blasterpoint]], he urged the [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] to contact the ''Cinzia''. Nebula informed the ''Cinzia'' that they would be boarded and Shinqo ordered [[Fekk]] and [[Gelss]]&mdash;two [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustans]] who had supported him in his mutiny&mdash;to prepare for action. However, the ''Cinzia'' suddenly [[Self-destruct mechanism/Legends|self-destructed]], and as Nebula jolted the ''Auriga Fire'' away from the explosion, Shinqo stumbled and was caught by Nebula's [[J8O soldier droid]], [[Clunker]]. Shinqo attempted to remain in control of the situation and threatened Nebula, but Nebula questioned with what Shinqo was threatening him&mdash;and then Shinqo realized that Clunker had taken his blaster from him when he'd stumbled. As Clunker held Shinqo at blasterpoint, the Rodian relented, allowing control of the ''Auriga Fire'' to return to Nebula. He later talked to the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Dao Stryver]] about the incident, leading Stryver to find Nebula in [[Tassaa Bareesh]]'s palace.

==Personality and traits==
Both Jet Nebula and Dao Stryer did not think highly of Shinqo, saying that he would say anything to get a blaster out of his face. However, Nebula also thought that Shinqo had the potential to make a good first mate.
